id: title:cohenroy:hide billing limit controls for products without limits

review.posthog_relevance: Billing product configuration and frontend enforcement of billing limits.
review.reason: This chunk implements frontend-only support for a billing limit configuration. P1.F1.H2 adds a backend-derived flag to the product type, P1.F5.H1 adds a utility check, and P1.F7.H2 uses that check to prevent setting unsupported billing limits. This establishes the frontend behavior and shared checks, but the tier is capped at 1 because the backend implementation and tests are not,
review.uncertainty: The tier is established solely on the basis of the frontend implementation and shared checks, while the backend implementation and tests are not,

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the backend implementation or tests for the billing limit enforcement, only the frontend changes. The backend change is not present, so the tier cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds a new optional field no_billing_limit to BillingProductV2Type.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the frontend to receive a flag from the backend indicating a product does not support billing limits.

observations.behavior: Adds a utility function canHaveBillingLimit to check if a product can have a billing limit.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared check for whether a product supports billing limits, used by the billing product logic.

observations.behavior: Adds a check in billingProductLogic to return null for customLimitUsd if the product cannot have a billing limit.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents the frontend from setting a billing limit for products that do not support it.
